gloss: New Year deity; god of the incoming year

definitions.gloss: New Year deity; god of the incoming year
definitions.explanation: A Shinto deity believed to visit each household at the start of the new year, bringing blessings of good harvest and prosperity. Many New Year traditions are rooted in welcoming this deity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{門松|かどまつ}→門松：14522_kadomatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{歳神様|としがみさま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: Kadomatsu decorations are displayed to welcome the New Year deity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鏡餅|かがみもち}→鏡餅：19469_kagamimochi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{歳神様|としがみさま}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{供|そな}え{物|もの}→お供え物：15307_osonaemono⟧だ。
examples.english: Kagami-mochi is an offering to the New Year deity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大掃除|おおそうじ}→大掃除：08347_oosouji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{歳神様|としがみさま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{清|きよ}らか→清らか：13316_kiyoraka⟧な⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{迎|むか}え→お迎え：27645_omukae⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Year-end cleaning is said to be a custom of welcoming the New Year deity into a clean home.

notes:
Also written as {年神様|としがみさま}. This deity is central to understanding Japanese New Year customs. Many traditions that seem decorative actually serve the purpose of welcoming, hosting, and sending off the {歳神様|としがみさま}.

Key New Year customs linked to this deity:
- ⟦{門松|かどまつ}→門松：14522_kadomatsu⟧: pine decorations at the entrance to guide the deity to the home
- ⟦{鏡餅|かがみもち}→鏡餅：19469_kagamimochi⟧: stacked rice cakes as an offering and dwelling place for the deity
- しめ{縄|なわ}: sacred rope marking the purified space
- ⟦{大掃除|おおそうじ}→大掃除：08347_oosouji⟧: year-end cleaning to prepare a pure environment
- ⟦お{年玉|としだま}→お年玉：08452_otoshidama⟧: originally referred to the rice cake distributed by the household head, representing the deity's blessing

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歳神様|としがみさま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to welcome the New Year deity
- {歳神様|としがみさま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{送|おく}り→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to see off the New Year deity
- {歳神様|としがみさま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{宿|やど}る→宿る：12351_yadoru⟧: for the deity to dwell (in the kagami-mochi)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {氏神|うじがみ}: tutelary deity — the local guardian god of a community
- {福|ふく}の{神|かみ}: god of fortune — a general term for deities bringing luck
